contract.purpose: Select one coded labor indicator tile and its critical-level result.

null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Invalid integer offset conversion propagates; NULL offset makes the midnight boundary NULL. NULL activity is excluded by NOT IN; the count branches have different explicit non-NULL checks. Unsupported tile does not emit a default zero tile.
output_shape: One count/critical-level result for each supported tile branch; unsupported or NULL tile produces no result set.

ordered_branches.explanation: Parse warehouse and integer browser offset; compute a UTC boundary representing browser midnight. Culture is unused.
Two tile branches count recent labor details or distinct users since UTC now minus one hour, with fixed activity exclusions. The third counts selected completed work since browser midnight.
Apply the critical-level helper using supplied caution/warning values. None of the time predicates establishes an upper window bound.
